_about: Words that can't appear in game titles or descriptions. A basic first filter, not moderation: reports and review still matter. 'words' match whole words (also with endings like -s, -ed, -ing, -er, and with letters swapped for look-alike digits or symbols); 'anywhere' also match inside longer words, so keep that list to strings that are never innocent; 'phrases' match whole phrases. Lower case.
